name: @vanillagreen/pi-nested-agents-md
description: Attaches a subdirectory's AGENTS.md to the model's context the first time a file under it is read. Pi loads the root AGENTS.md and the ancestors of the cwd only; this adds the nested ones, once per session per file, bounded by the project root.
